orphan_drug_act_status: Enacted Jan 4, 1983 (P.L. 97-414); first approval granted (Lithostat, May 1983)
statutory_framework: Orphan Drug Act established 7-year market exclusivity, clinical research tax credits, and protocol assistance.
landmark_approvals: Sandimmune (cyclosporine, organ transplant breakthrough), Zantac (ranitidine, 1st $1B drug), Lithostat (1st orphan drug)
historical_significance: Pivotal turning point: federal policy explicitly incentivized rare disease therapies, while Sandimmune enabled modern solid organ transplantation.
primary_source_basis: openFDA Drugs@FDA, FDA OOPD Orphan Drug Database, HHS Historical Reports, Washington Post (1986-01-15)

orphan_drug_act_status: First full year under Orphan Drug Act; Trexan (naltrexone) approved for opioid dependence
statutory_framework: Drug Price Competition and Patent Term Restoration Act of 1984 (Hatch-Waxman Act, P.L. 98-417, Sept 24, 1984) created Section 505(j) ANDA generic pathway and patent term restoration.
landmark_approvals: Nicorette (1st smoking cessation aid), Trexan (naltrexone, opioid addiction blockade), Rocephin (gold-standard cephalosporin), Augmentin (1st beta-lactamase inhibitor combo)
historical_significance: Foundational year for modern pharma: Hatch-Waxman balanced generic competition with innovator patent restoration, while FDA recognized behavioral addiction pharmacotherapy.
primary_source_basis: openFDA Drugs@FDA, FDA CDER Historical Archive, Federal Register Vol 49, New York Times Archive (1984-01-18, 1984-11-29)

orphan_drug_act_status: Orphan designations expanding (Protropin, Marinol); modern CDER NME Compilation baseline start year
statutory_framework: Full implementation of Hatch-Waxman ANDA regulations; FDA's 1985 modern NDA rewrite regulations went into effect.
landmark_approvals: Protropin (recombinant somatrem, Genentech early biotech), Vasotec (enalapril), Seldane (terfenadine), Marinol (dronabinol), Ridaura, Fortaz
historical_significance: Record post-1962 drug approval count (31 NMEs); marks official starting baseline for CDER's modern NME compilation and biotech therapeutic protein era.
primary_source_basis: FDA CDER NME Compilation (1985-2025), fda_decisions_master.csv (D1029-D1059), Washington Post (1986-01-15)
